D/ IMP CONSTA [NTINVS] ; R/ VICTORIAE LAE[TAE PRINC PERP]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Victoriae Laetae Princ Perp issue of 318-320, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Helmeted bust with crest, laureate, cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP CONSTA [NTINVS]. Reverse description: Two Victories holding shield over altar. Reverse inscription: VICTORIAE LAE[TAE PRINC PERP]. In exergue: TR?P.? Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 17.4mm, Weight: 2.99gms, die axis: 12
